name: BT Volume Construction
aliases: BT Volume Approximation via Least Squares
definition: A two-step generation process for BT Volumes: first via least-squares approximation of an arbitrary volumetric function, second by pre-convolving a reconstruction filter with an arbitrary scalar rectilinear volume.
summary: BT Volume Construction approximates scalar fields via least-squares fitting to ensure C0 continuity across tetrahedral boundaries, differing from direct discretization.
